messages:
maria/docs: Opening PR #3571 to migrate audit-log examples to JSONL, add SDK migration notes (v0.x -> v1.x), and clarify retention/SOC2 wording. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/3571

lee-privacy: Quick note: avoid absolutes in public-facing SOC2 language. Instead of 'we never share logs' suggest 'access to logs is restricted and governed by contract and policy.' Also add a short line on data minimization.

alex-legal: Agreed with @lee-privacy. Also add an explicit export/legal-hold flow: 'Customers may request exports or legal holds per their contract; contact legal@redwood.ai with the case ID.' Do not publish retention durations as absolute promises.

raj-devex: Looking at the examples — the Python sample currently uses json.dump(records, f) which writes a single array. For our streaming consumers we should emit newline-delimited JSON (JSONL). Example change:
```
for r in records:
    print(json.dumps(r))  # newline-delimited JSON for streaming/ingest
```

nora-product: Can we include a short "What changed" migration checklist for customers? e.g. 1) JSON -> JSONL, 2) client.log_event renamed to client.audit_log_write, 3) env var REDWOOD_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS available for on-prem/private.

sam-infra: CI schema validator flagged example record #2: missing required fields 'event_id' and 'actor'. If we redact values, please include placeholders like "<REDACTED>" rather than omitting keys — that keeps the canonical schema visible and avoids test failures.

ci-bot: CI / docs-lint — failed. details: examples/audit-log/jsonl: record 2 -> missing required field 'event_id'. Triggered by PR #3571.

maria/docs: Thanks — I'll replace omitted fields with placeholders and add an MDX admonition 'Redaction vs required fields' showing which fields can be stripped for demo data and which must be present in API payloads. Also fixing an internal link: /legal/retention-policy -> /legal/data-retention.

lee-privacy: Add a brief SOC2 alignment sentence: 'Access controls and retention practices are implemented in accordance with our SOC2 Type II controls.' Keep it short and non-technical.

alex-legal: One nit: change contact wording to 'contact legal@redwood.ai with the case ID and requester details'. Also remove the word 'permanent' if it's present anywhere.

raj-devex: Pushed an update with Ruby + Python JSONL examples and the migration checklist. Ruby snippet: 
```
records.each do |r|
  puts r.to_json
end
```
Python snippet included above. I also added the placeholder pattern for tenant_id/event_id in the canonical schema.

ci-bot: CI / docs-lint — re-run in progress...

ci-bot: CI / docs-lint — all checks passed. examples/audit-log/jsonl validated, links updated.

maria/docs: Great, thank you all. I'll merge once the one-hour freeze window ends, add a small changelog entry referencing SDK migration notes, and ping #support and #product to surface the change. :white_check_mark:

nora-product: Thanks — I will include a short note in the upcoming release highlights about the JSONL change and the client API rename.

maria/docs: Merged and closing thread. If anyone wants to follow up on wording I left a small comment in the PR for @alex-legal.

alex-legal: LGTM apart from that tiny wording comment. Thanks!
